text.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ سَأَلَ سَآئِلٌۢ بِعَذَابٍۢ وَاقِعٍۢ

translations.asad: ONE who is minded to ask might ask about the suffering which [in the hereafter] is bound to befall
translations.sahih: A supplicant asked for a punishment bound to happen

translations.asad: those who deny the truth. [Know, then, that] nothing can ward it off,
translations.sahih: To the disbelievers; of it there is no preventer.

translations.asad: [since it will come] from God, unto whom there are many ways of ascent:
translations.sahih: [It is] from Allah, owner of the ways of ascent.

text.arabic: تَعْرُجُ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ وَٱلرُّوحُ إِلَيْهِ فِى يَوْمٍۢ كَانَ مِقْدَارُهُۥ خَمْسِينَ أَلْفَ سَنَةٍۢ

translations.asad: all the angels and all the inspiration [ever granted to man] ascend unto Him [daily,] in a day the length whereof is [like] fifty thousand years…
translations.sahih: The angels and the Spirit will ascend to Him during a Day the extent of which is fifty thousand years.

translations.asad: Therefore, [O believer,] endure all adversity with goodly patience:
translations.sahih: So be patient with gracious patience.

translations.asad: behold, men look upon that [reckoning] as something far away –
translations.sahih: Indeed, they see it [as] distant,

translations.asad: but, We see it as near!
translations.sahih: But We see it [as] near.

translations.asad: [It will take place] on a Day when the sky will be like molten lead,
translations.sahih: On the Day the sky will be like murky oil,

translations.asad: and the mountains will be like tufts of wool,
translations.sahih: And the mountains will be like wool,

translations.asad: and [when] no friend will ask about his friend,
translations.sahih: And no friend will ask [anything of] a friend,

text.arabic: يُبَصَّرُونَهُمْ ۚ يَوَدُّ ٱلْمُجْرِمُ لَوْ يَفْتَدِى مِنْ عَذَابِ يَوْمِئِذٍۭ بِبَنِيهِ

translations.asad: though they may be in one another's sight: [for,] everyone who was lost in sin will on that Day but desire to ransom himself from suffering at the price of his own children,
translations.sahih: They will be shown each other. The criminal will wish that he could be ransomed from the punishment of that Day by his children

translations.asad: and of his spouse, and of his brother,
translations.sahih: And his wife and his brother

translations.asad: and of all the kinsfolk who ever sheltered him,
translations.sahih: And his nearest kindred who shelter him

text.arabic: وَمَن فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ جَمِيعًۭا ثُمَّ يُنجِيهِ

translations.asad: and of whoever [else] lives on earth, all of them - so that he could but save himself.
translations.sahih: And whoever is on earth entirely [so] then it could save him.

translations.asad: But nay! Verily, all [that awaits him] is a raging flame,
translations.sahih: No! Indeed, it is the Flame [of Hell],

translations.asad: tearing away his skin!
translations.sahih: A remover of exteriors.

translations.asad: It will claim all such as turn their backs [on what is right], and turn away [from the truth],
translations.sahih: It invites he who turned his back [on truth] and went away [from obedience]

translations.asad: and amass [wealth] and thereupon withhold [it from their fellow-men].
translations.sahih: And collected [wealth] and hoarded.

translations.asad: VERILY, man is born with a restless disposition.
translations.sahih: Indeed, mankind was created anxious:

translations.asad: [As a rule,] whenever misfortune touches him, he is filled with self-pity;
translations.sahih: When evil touches him, impatient,

translations.asad: and whenever good fortune comes to him, he selfishly withholds it [from others].
translations.sahih: And when good touches him, withholding [of it],

translations.asad: Not so, however, those who consciously turn towards God in prayer.
translations.sahih: Except the observers of prayer -

translations.asad: [and] who incessantly persevere in their prayer
translations.sahih: Those who are constant in their prayer

translations.asad: and in whose possessions there is a due share, acknowledged [by them],
translations.sahih: And those within whose wealth is a known right

translations.asad: for such as ask [for help] and such as are deprived [of what is good in life];
translations.sahih: For the petitioner and the deprived -

translations.asad: and who accept as true the [coming of the] Day of Judgment;
translations.sahih: And those who believe in the Day of Recompense

text.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُم مِّنْ عَذَابِ رَبِّهِم مُّشْفِقُونَ

translations.asad: and who stand in dread of their Sustainer's chastisement –
translations.sahih: And those who are fearful of the punishment of their Lord -

translations.asad: for, behold, of their Sustainer's chastisement none may ever feel [wholly] secure;
translations.sahih: Indeed, the punishment of their Lord is not that from which one is safe -

translations.asad: and who are mindful of their chastity,
translations.sahih: And those who guard their private parts

text.arabic: إِلَّا عَلَىٰٓ أَزْوَٰجِهِمْ أَوْ مَا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَٰنُهُمْ فَإِنَّهُمْ غَيْرُ مَلُومِينَ

translations.asad: [not giving way to their desires] with any but their spouses - that is, those whom they rightfully possess [through wedlock] -: for then, behold, they are free of all blame,
translations.sahih: Except from their wives or those their right hands possess, for indeed, they are not to be blamed -

text.arabic: فَمَنِ ٱبْتَغَىٰ وَرَآءَ ذَٰلِكَ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْعَادُونَ

translations.asad: whereas such as seek to go beyond that [limit] are truly transgressors;
translations.sahih: But whoever seeks beyond that, then they are the transgressors -

translations.asad: and who are faithful to their trusts and to their pledges:
translations.sahih: And those who are to their trusts and promises attentive

translations.asad: and who stand firm whenever they bear witness;
translations.sahih: And those who are in their testimonies upright

translations.asad: and who guard their prayers [from all worldly intent].
translations.sahih: And those who [carefully] maintain their prayer:

translations.asad: These it is who in the gardens [of paradise] shall be honoured!
translations.sahih: They will be in gardens, honored.

translations.asad: WHAT, THEN, is amiss with such as are bent on denying the truth, that they run about confusedly to and fro before thee,
translations.sahih: So what is [the matter] with those who disbelieve, hastening [from] before you, [O Muhammad],

translations.asad: [coming upon thee] from the right and from the left, in crowds?
translations.sahih: [To sit] on [your] right and [your] left in separate groups?

text.arabic: أَيَطْمَعُ كُلُّ ٱمْرِئٍۢ مِّنْهُمْ أَن يُدْخَلَ جَنَّةَ نَعِيمٍۢ

translations.asad: Does every one of them hope to enter [by this means] a garden of bliss?
translations.sahih: Does every person among them aspire to enter a garden of pleasure?

translations.asad: Never! For, behold, We have created them out of something that they know [only too well]!
translations.sahih: No! Indeed, We have created them from that which they know.

text.arabic: فَلَآ أُقْسِمُ بِرَبِّ ٱلْمَشَٰرِقِ وَٱلْمَغَٰرِبِ إِنَّا لَقَٰدِرُونَ

translations.asad: But nay! I call to witness [Our being] the Sustainer of all the points of sunrise and sunset: verily, well able are We
translations.sahih: So I swear by the Lord of [all] risings and settings that indeed We are able

text.arabic: عَلَىٰٓ أَن نُّبَدِّلَ خَيْرًۭا مِّنْهُمْ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمَسْبُوقِينَ

translations.asad: to replace them with [people] better than they are; for there is nothing to prevent Us [from doing what We will].
translations.sahih: To replace them with better than them; and We are not to be outdone.

text.arabic: فَذَرْهُمْ يَخُوضُوا۟ وَيَلْعَبُوا۟ حَتَّىٰ يُلَٰقُوا۟ يَوْمَهُمُ ٱلَّذِى يُوعَدُونَ

translations.asad: Hence, leave them to indulge in idle talk and play [with words] until they face that [Judgment] Day of theirs which they have been promised –
translations.sahih: So leave them to converse vainly and amuse themselves until they meet their Day which they are promised -

text.arabic: يَوْمَ يَخْرُجُونَ مِنَ ٱلْأَجْدَاثِ سِرَاعًۭا كَأَنَّهُمْ إِلَىٰ نُصُبٍۢ يُوفِضُونَ

translations.asad: the Day when they shall come forth in haste from their graves, as if racing towards a goal-post,
translations.sahih: The Day they will emerge from the graves rapidly as if they were, toward an erected idol, hastening.

text.arabic: خَٰشِعَةً أَبْصَٰرُهُمْ تَرْهَقُهُمْ ذِلَّةٌۭ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمُ ٱلَّذِى كَانُوا۟ يُوعَدُونَ

translations.asad: with downcast eyes, with ignominy overwhelming them: that Day which they were promised again and…
translations.sahih: Their eyes humbled, humiliation will cover them. That is the Day which they had been promised.
